title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has released a minor update, watchOS 5.0.1
text:
September 28, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has released a minor update, watchOS 5.0.1
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has released a minor update, watchOS 5.0.1 to the public, patch to the Apple Watch’s operating system (OS) fixing a charging issue, and also fixing some activity-related problems that hampered attempts by users to close their rings.
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) ‘s update first resolves a problem where a small number of users seeing increases in exercise minutes, and also making the tracking of user activities throughout the day not accurate. In the second update it addresses the bug, with an issue where some users did not receive Stand credit in the afternoon.
